run_restore_state_cli: run the restore_state CLI to download S3 run data to a local destination folder
copy_files_from_s3: copy files from an S3 bucket path to a local destination folder using boto3
init_s3_resource: initialize an S3 boto3 resource with AWS credentials from environment variables
split_s3_path: split an S3 path string into bucket name and key using regex parsing
get_name_from_path: extract the final filename component from a path string by splitting on slashes
